messages:
Priya (AE): @Marcus looping you in — Chameleon wants a 2-week POC to validate replacing CompetitorX with Redwood. Primary asks: prompt parity, response determinism, pricing comparison, and EU data residency/KMS. Can we do network-isolated POC?
Marcus (SE): Hi — yes we can. Two deployment options: hosted with EU region + customer-managed KMS in Dedicated/Private. Hosted POC with IP allowlist possible but KMS needs Dedicated/Private.
Alex (Sales Engineer): Pricing question from them — how do we bill tokens during POC? They want to avoid surprise overages.
Marcus (SE): We can set a capped trial invoice + usage dashboard. Recommend a fixed credit for the 2 weeks and explicit per-token rate for any overage. I can draft numbers.
Chameleon Pilot (customer): Important: prompt outputs must match our current model within 5% of response similarity on our 300 test prompts. Also need stable retry semantics and same streaming chunks.
Sam (Solutions): For parity tests we should ask them to send the 300 prompt set + desired comparison metric (BLEU / embedding cosine / human-rated). We'll run A/B against CompetitorX and Redwood base model.
Marcus (SE): Agreed. Also call out tokenization deltas — CompetitorX uses byte-level BPE variant; we'll need to normalize before comparing. Recommend returning both raw tokens and decoded text for debug.
Priya (AE): Can we give them an automated diff report per prompt? That helps their legal/ops signoff.
Marcus (SE): We have an eval harness — can generate diff CSV + example explanations. Will include: prompt, competitor_response, redwood_response, embedding_cosine, token_count_delta.
Ivy (Security): From sec side — they asked about SOC2, EU data residency, and KMS. Clarify: hosted EU region stores data in EU, but if they require customer-managed KMS and zero-uptime keys we need Dedicated/Private. Also need to discuss logging retention and access controls.
Chameleon Pilot (customer): They also want to run the model in an air-gapped environment eventually. Is that feasible?
Nate (Eng-Infra): Air-gapped is Private on-prem only. It requires install of our private control plane and some infra checklist (NAT, firewall, DNS). We can provide an installer image but lead time is ~6 weeks.
Marcus (SE): For the POC timeline: week 0 — infra & creds, week 1 — import prompt set & run baseline, week 2 — tuning (quantization/params) + final report. Need customer IPs for allowlist and sample payloads.
Alex (Sales Engineer): Contract asks: temporary NDA + POC SOW with acceptance criteria tied to the 300 prompts. I'll draft with a credit cap and a clause for Dedicated migration if they proceed.
Chameleon Pilot (customer): Are there known response deltas from switching runtimes (e.g., different tokenization, beam sampling)? We need minimal drift.
Marcus (SE): Known deltas: tokenization differences, default sampling seeds, temperature/stop-sequence handling. We'll map CompetitorX params to Redwood equivalents; sample mapping below: 
```
// CompetitorX request
{
  "prompt": "...",
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "stop": ["\\n\\n"]
}
// Redwood mapping
{
  "input": "...",
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "max_output_tokens": 512,
  "stop_sequences": ["\\n\\n"]
}
```
Marcus (SE): Also we have a compatibility shim option: proxy that translates CompetitorX calls to Redwood. That can reduce integration work but may not perfectly match low-level tokenization.
Sam (Solutions): For acceptance, propose thresholds: embedding cosine >= 0.92 on average, top-1 semantic match 88%, and <10% token_count variance. Also human sample pass-rate 90% on critical prompts.
Ivy (Security): Add requirement: pen-test schedule or attestation for Dedicated deployment. Also they asked for a data flow diagram and retention policy — Nate can supply.
Nate (Eng-Infra): I'll export the infra checklist and retention policy. Will need contact for their network team to coordinate IPs/security groups.
Marcus (SE): Blockers: if they insist on customer KMS in hosted model that's a no-go — need Dedicated. Also very low-latency streaming parity may require adjusting chunk sizes.
Priya (AE): Next actions: Marcus to send POC SOW and eval harness link, Alex to propose trial credit and pricing cap, Nate to send infra checklist, Ivy to prepare security matrix. Chameleon — can you share the 300-prompt set and network contact by EOD tomorrow? :eyes: :rocket:
Chameleon Pilot (customer): Yes, will share prompts and infra contact tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone.
DeployBot: POC workspace created: workspace-chameleon-poc (ID: poc-1931). Invite sent to Priya, Marcus, Alex, Sam, Ivy, Nate.
